walkthrough.gettingStarted.title: Get Started with OzBridge
walkthrough.gettingStarted.description: Install Warp, run your first Oz agent from Copilot Chat, explore the Warp views and enable the MCP bridge.
walkthrough.step.installCli.title: Install the Warp CLI
walkthrough.step.installCli.description: Download Warp (≥ 0.2024.x) so OzBridge can locate the `oz` executable on your PATH. This step is marked complete the first time OzBridge successfully calls the `oz_list_runs` tool.
walkthrough.step.firstAgent.title: Run your first @oz prompt
walkthrough.step.firstAgent.description: Open a Copilot Chat view and invoke @oz with a short prompt to run an Oz agent end-to-end.
walkthrough.step.exploreViews.title: Explore the OzBridge views
walkthrough.step.exploreViews.descriptio: Open the Runs and Warp Drive views from the Activity Bar to manage runs, skills and prompts.
walkthrough.step.enableMcp.title: Enable the MCP bridge (optional)
walkthrough.step.enableMcp.description: Toggle ozBridge.mcpEnabled or run OzBridge: Start MCP server to let Claude Code, Cursor or Codex drive OzBridge over MCP.
